subject: humanities
passage: Instead of tearing down old industrial buildings, some cities have turned them into places for art. ______ the Tate Modern, one of the most visited art museums in London, occupies a former power station on the bank of the River Thames that stopped producing electricity in 1981.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

explanation.why: The first sentence makes a general claim: some cities turn old industrial buildings into places for art. The second sentence names one specific case: a London art museum in a former power station. A transition that introduces an example is needed.
explanation.A: Incorrect. The Tate Modern supports the general claim rather than contrasting with it.
explanation.B: Correct. "For example" introduces the Tate Modern as one industrial building that has been turned into a place for art.
explanation.C: Incorrect. "Instead" would mean the museum is an alternative to the practice just described, but it is a case of that practice.
explanation.D: Incorrect. "Similarly" would compare the Tate Modern to an earlier example, but no example has been given yet.
